review.method: Visual review with local Whisper transcript support

steps.title: Open the visual editor
steps.instruction: Select Edit to open the Wikipedia visual editor.

steps.title: Create a visual link
steps.instruction: Select the word, choose the link tool, and select the correct article.

steps.title: Publish the visual edit
steps.instruction: Select Publish changes, enter an edit summary, and confirm the change.

steps.title: Open the source editor
steps.instruction: Open the editor menu and select source editing.

steps.title: Create a source link
steps.instruction: Put double square brackets around the word, then publish the edit.
